title: Gaussian BROJA Partial Information Decomposition in Closed Form
abstract: arXiv:2610.13464v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The BROJA partial information decomposition provides an operationally motivated way to separate the information that two sources carry about a target into unique, redundant, and synergistic components. For continuous and high-dimensional variables, however, computing the BROJA decomposition requires solving a difficult optimization problem. Previous work showed that, when each source-target pair is jointly Gaussian, the problem can be reduced to finite-dimensional numerical optimization. Here, we derive a closed-form solution to this optimization problem, enabling direct computation of the BROJA decomposition in the general multivariate Gaussian setting. The resulting closed-form expression enables speedups exceeding two orders of magnitude for high-dimensional Gaussian BROJA PID. Code is available at https://github.com/brainsandmachines/Eigen_PID.

translated_title: 闭式解形式的高斯BROJA部分信息分解
translated_abstract: BROJA部分信息分解提供了一种具有操作性动机的方法，可将两个信源所携带的关于目标的信息分离为独有、冗余和协同三种成分。然而，对于连续变量和高维变量，计算BROJA分解需要求解一个困难的优化问题。先前的工作表明，当每个信源-目标对服从联合高斯分布时，该问题可以简化为有限维数值优化。在本工作中，我们推导出了该优化问题的闭式解，使得在一般的多变量高斯设置下能够直接计算BROJA分解。所得的闭式表达式使高维高斯BROJA PID的计算速度提升超过两个数量级。代码可在 https://github.com/brainsandmachines/Eigen_PID 获取。
tldr: 本文推导出了高斯BROJA部分信息分解优化问题的闭式解，使一般多变量高斯情形下的分解可以直接计算，并将高维计算的速度提升超过两个数量级。
